exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 Planning a Camping Trip
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lucy: Jack, shall we go camping in the mountains this weekend?
Jack: That sounds great. But the weather can change fast up there.
Lucy: True. I checked the forecast, and it said it would stay dry until Sunday.
Jack: Good. Then we should bring warm coats. The nights get really cold.
Lucy: I was going to pack a small first aid kit too, in case someone gets hurt.
Jack: Smart idea. I'll bring the tent and some food.
Lucy: Perfect. Let's leave early on Saturday morning, before the crowds.
Jack: Agreed. This will be our best adventure yet!
exercises.translation_cn: Lucy 提议周末去山里露营;Jack 担心天气多变;Lucy 说天气预报称周日前不会下雨;两人决定带保暖外套,因为夜里很冷;Lucy 还打算带急救包以防受伤;Jack 负责帐篷和食物;两人约定周六一早趁人少出发。

There would be a storm on Saturday.

options: Because the nights get very cold.

Because they have nothing else to wear.

When do they plan to leave?

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 Facts about Qomolangma
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Qomolangma lies on the border between Nepal and China.
It is the highest mountain in the world.
The best time to climb it is in April and May.
The temperature there can drop as low as minus sixty degrees.
The first climbers confirmed to reach the top did so in 1953.
exercises.translation_cn: 珠穆朗玛峰位于尼泊尔和中国的边界上;它是世界最高峰;最佳攀登时间是4月和5月;那里的气温可低至零下六十度;最早被证实登顶的登山者是在1953年完成的。

questions.stem: Where does Qomolangma lie?
options: In the middle of the ocean.
On the border between Nepal and China.

questions.stem: When is the best time to climb it?
How cold can it get on the mountain?
options: As low as minus sixty degrees.

questions.stem: When were the first climbers confirmed to reach the top?
What does the passage mainly tell us?
options: How to cook on a mountain.
The history of one climber's life.

exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 An Interview about a Cycling Trip
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Host: So, Tom, why did you cycle all that way?
Tom: We did it to raise money for children in need.
Host: That's wonderful. How did you prepare for such a hard trip?
Tom: We practised a lot. If we weren't studying, we were out on our bikes.
Host: What difficulties did you meet on the road?
Tom: We had to climb steep hills day after day, and we faced falling rocks too.
Host: And how did you feel when it was all over?
Tom: It was the best feeling in the world. We had an adventure and helped others.
exercises.translation_cn: 主持人问 Tom 为何骑行那么远;Tom 说是为有需要的孩子筹款;问他如何准备,Tom 说勤加练习,不学习时就骑车;路上的困难是日复一日爬陡坡、还有落石;结束时他感觉好极了,既冒了险又帮了人。

questions.stem: Why did Tom and his friends cycle so far?
options: To raise money for children in need.

questions.stem: How did they prepare for the trip?
options: They practised a lot on their bikes.

questions.stem: What was one difficulty they met?
options: The trip was far too easy.

questions.stem: What danger did they face on the road?
How did Tom feel when the trip ended?
options: It was the best feeling in the world.
He was sorry he had started.
He felt bored and tired of it.
He never wanted to ride again.

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 Jules Verne, Father of Science Fiction
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Jules Verne was a French writer who lived in the nineteenth century.
He is often called the Father of Science Fiction.
In his stories, he described machines years before they were really made.
One famous book follows a journey deep under the sea.
Even today, millions of readers still enjoy his amazing adventures.
exercises.translation_cn: 儒勒·凡尔纳是生活在19世纪的法国作家;他常被称为'科幻小说之父';在故事里,他在机器真正造出来之前数年就描写了它们;一部名著讲述了一段深海之旅;直到今天,数百万读者仍喜爱他精彩的冒险故事。

options: He wrote only about his own city.

options: A journey deep under the sea.

exercises.title: U5 听力·对话 Booking a Diving Tour
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Visitor: Hello, I'd like to book a diving tour for this Saturday.
Guide: Of course. Would you prefer a wreck dive or a scenic dive?
Visitor: What's the difference between them?
Guide: On a wreck dive, you visit an old ship that sank long ago.
Visitor: And the scenic dive?
Guide: You swim with the grey seals that live around the islands all year.
Visitor: That sounds lovely. Are the seals dangerous?
Guide: Not at all. The young ones are curious and will follow you about.
exercises.translation_cn: 游客想预订本周六的潜水团;向导问他要沉船潜水还是观光潜水;游客问两者区别;向导说沉船潜水去看一艘很久前沉没的旧船,观光潜水则和常年生活在群岛周围的灰海豹一起游;游客担心海豹危险,向导说一点也不,小海豹很好奇,会跟着人。

questions.stem: What does the visitor want to do?
options: Book a diving tour for Saturday.

questions.stem: What can you see on a wreck dive?
options: An old ship that sank long ago.

questions.stem: What do divers do on the scenic dive?
options: They swim with the grey seals.

questions.stem: How long do the seals live around the islands?

options: They are curious and follow divers.

exercises.title: U5 听力·短文 A Tip for Adventurers
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip before you go on any adventure.
Always learn some first aid, so you can help if someone is hurt.
Tell a friend where you are going and when you plan to come back.
Check the weather, and never set out if a storm is coming.
With good planning, even a hard trip can become a safe and happy one.
exercises.translation_cn: 出发去任何冒险之前给你一个小贴士:先学点急救,以便有人受伤时能帮忙;把你的去向和计划返回的时间告诉朋友;查看天气,有风暴来临时绝不出发;有了周密计划,再难的旅程也能变得安全又快乐。

questions.stem: Who is this tip for?

options: To help if someone gets hurt.

questions.stem: What should you tell a friend?
options: Where you are going and when you will return.

questions.stem: When should you never set out?
What can good planning do, according to the passage?
options: Make a hard trip safe and happy.
